summary.headline: Planetary Squares and Trines
summary.text: Astrological delineations of planetary trines and squares: Mars, Sun, Venus, and Mercury trine the Moon, while Saturn’s squares to Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, and Venus affect health, property, fathers, relatives, marriage, and reputation.
